basis: On AXT’s public Q3 earnings call, CFO Gary Fischer said, “we expect Q4 revenue to be between $26 million and $29 million.” This was AXT’s company-wide revenue outlook for the quarter ending December 31, 2022. Its $29,000,000 high end was below $35,845,400, or 95% of the prior-year quarter’s $37,732,000 consolidated GAAP revenue.

coverage.detail: July 28, 2022. The preceding-cycle Q2 earnings release gave no numeric Q4 consolidated revenue outlook.
On the July 28 call, management guided Q3 revenue to $39 million–$41 million. Its discussion of Q4 supplied no company-wide revenue ceiling.
The August IPO exhibit forecast Beijing Tongmei’s January–September operating revenue in renminbi. Both the reporting entity and the period differ from AXT’s consolidated December quarter.
October 3, 2022. AXT cut its July guidance to $34 million–$35 million explicitly for Q3, which ended September 30. Publication during Q4 does not make this a Q4 forecast.

October 27, 2022. The written Q3 release reported $35.2 million of Q3 revenue and announced the public call for 1:30 p.m. Pacific. Its Q4 timing reference concerned Tongmei’s proposed IPO. The revenue outlook came during the call.

The transcript of the October 27 public call records Fischer’s $26 million–$29 million Q4 revenue range after CEO Morris Young handed the call back to him for fourth-quarter guidance. AXT’s event page independently establishes the call date and time.
December 28, 2022. AXT announced a January 11, 2023 public investor presentation. The announcement contained no revised revenue range. This event followed the October 27 guidance.

February 16, 2023. AXT’s condensed consolidated statements of operations report revenue of $26,795,000 and $37,732,000 for the three months ended December 31, 2022 and 2021, respectively. The actual fell within the October range.

publication_date_evidence: AXT’s investor-relations event page dates the public Q3 call October 27, 2022 at 4:30 p.m. Eastern. The same-day SEC exhibit announced the webcast, and the readable call transcript preserves management’s quarter-specific guidance.
